name: Google Drive files.list metadata-only scope and read-only boundary
trigger: Grant only the synthetic Drive metadata readonly scope, list three synthetic files in two pages, then attempt a write.
observe: page token returns the remaining metadata
file content and unrequested fields are absent
write is rejected and world state remains unchanged
no external request or real credential is used
expected: Two pages expose only metadata under the readonly scope; write returns 403 with zero mutations.
